description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing employee skills in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, list, create, update, and delete employee skill records, leveraging the EmployeeSkillService and defining detailed validation and OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API for employee skill operations: get, list, create, update, delete. It uses dependency injection for the EmployeeSkillService, includes detailed validation rules, and contains OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeSkillService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific employee skill by its ID for a given employee.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all skills for a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new skill for an employee.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing employee skill.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or more skills from an employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Creates or updates an EmployeeSkill entity based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for optional body parameters like comments and years of experience.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Returns a validation rule ensuring the employee number is accessible.
